items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Chuck Wayne? [INTERVIEWEE] Chuck Wayne, you got it. It's all probably there already.

ctx.x: Chuck Wayne, you got it. It's all probably there already. It was a good run for a while. It was OK because people who love the guitar would come in. That was the name of the restaurant. It was cool. It was fun, but low key, you know, nothing where we had a high visibility, but it was OK. I remember Papa Jo Jones used to come in and sit way at the end of the bar. He always had brushes with him somewhere and newspaper so sometimes I'd hear these brushes going and we'd be playing all of a sudden!
